messages.content: Extract explicit persistent post-unit state only. Never infer a state from activity. Return JSON only.

message.reasoning:
We need to extract explicit persistent post-unit facts from the source unit: "Amy gets Will and Amber into the basement and locks the basement door."

So we have entities: Amy, Will, Amber, basement door.

Facts:

- Amy gets Will and Amber into the basement => set_location for Will and Amber? The rule 1 says set_location only when SOURCE UNIT explicitly puts an entity at/in/to a named destination. "into the basement" is a location. So set_location for Will: value "basement". For Amber: same.

Also maybe Amy gets them into basement, but not her own location; she might be in basement too? The phrase "gets Will and Amber into the basement" implies they are moved to basement, but doesn't say Amy's location changed. She could already be there or moving with them. But we only set for those explicitly put at/in/to a named destination: Will and Amber.

- locks the basement door => barrier state locked. So set_barrier_state for "basement door" value "locked".

Anything else? No item states, no threat states, etc.

Thus output JSON array of operations:

[
 {"op":"set_location","entity":"Will","value":"basement"},
 {"op":"set_location","entity":"Amber","value":"basement"},
 {"op":"set_barrier_state","entity":"basement door","value":"locked"}
]

Wrap in {"state_effects":[...]}.
